description: This PHP source file contains utility functions for handling calendar-related features in vtiger CRM, including calculating activity durations, converting times, and checking user availability for scheduling.

methods.name: get_duration
methods.description: Calculates the end time of an activity based on start time, duration in hours and minutes.

methods.name: time_to_number
methods.description: Converts a time string (HH:MM) into a numeric format for comparison.

methods.name: status_availability
methods.description: Determines user availability (busy or free) for a given time slot, considering activities and recurring events.
